name: Alpha Capital Group
status_note: Trustpilot currently shows no rating for Alpha Capital Group: it says the rating is unavailable because of a breach of its guidelines and that it removed fake reviews (seen October 19, 2026).
legal_entity_and_hq: Alpha Capital Group Limited, England and Wales company no. 13719951, registered office 1 Allied Business Centre, Coldharbour Lane, Harpenden, England, AL5 4UT (Companies House). The firm calls itself London-based; its Terms give 6-7 Waterside Station Road, Harpenden AL5 4US
instruments: Forex, metals, indices and oil CFDs (simulated)

programs.name: Alpha Pro 8%
programs.consistency_rule: none on bi-weekly payouts; on-demand payouts require that no single day is more than 40% of total profit
programs.profit_split: 80%; 90% with the optional 90% Profit Split add-on bought at purchase
programs.payout_frequency: chosen at purchase: Bi-Weekly (first request 14 days after the first trade on the Qualified account, then every 14 days) or On-Demand (any time once eligible)
programs.payout_rules_note: Bi-Weekly: at least 5 trading days with the same strategy before the first request, minimum $100 gross. On-Demand: minimum 2% of gross profit and the 40% best-day rule. Paid within 2 business days. A 0.25% bonus on the initial size is added to the 4th payout. No fee refund is published (return policy: 'All sales are final'). Max risk per asset 2% on 50K Qualified accounts bought after 2026-07-21 (hard breach). The payout choice also sets the base price.
programs.notes: Phase 1 target 8% ($4,000), Phase 2 5% ($2,500). Daily loss 4%, balance-based, reset 00:00 GMT+3. Minimum 3 trading days per phase. Leverage FX 1:100, metals 1:30, indices 1:20, oil 1:10. Max 20 lots on 50K. Weekend holding allowed in Phases 1-2 but not on the Qualified account (profits from those trades removed). Variants: Pro 6% (targets 6%/6%, 6% static, 3% daily on the greater of balance or equity) and Pro 10% (targets 10%/5%, 10% static, 5% daily balance-based). Price not published in readable form (see uncertain).

programs.name: Alpha One 10%
programs.drawdown_type: trailing on balance high-water mark (6%), fixed at the initial balance once the balance reaches +6%
programs.consistency_rule: on-demand payouts: no single day more than 40% of total profit
programs.payout_frequency: on demand (Bi-Weekly is offered on Alpha Pro and Alpha Three only)
programs.payout_rules_note: On-Demand: minimum 2% of gross profit, 40% best-day rule. Paid within 2 business days. Max risk per asset 2% on 50K Qualified accounts bought after 2026-07-21. No fee refund published.
programs.notes: Daily loss 4%, calculated on the greater of the prior end-of-day balance or equity. Leverage FX 1:30, metals 1:9, indices 1:10, oil 1:10. Weekend holding allowed at all stages. Variants: One 6% (target 6%, max 4% trailing, daily 3% in evaluation / 4% on Qualified) and One 12% (target 12%, max 8% trailing, daily 5%, sizes up to $100K). Max lots at 50K not confirmed for this plan.

programs.name: Alpha Direct
programs.consistency_rule: 15% best-day rule (no single day more than 15% of total profit)
programs.payout_rules_note: A 3% profit buffer ($1,500 on 50K) must be built and kept in the account; then minimum 1% of gross profit per request. KYC via Veriff before the first payout. Max risk per asset 1% (losses on the same asset and direction within 10 minutes combined).
programs.notes: Qualified from purchase, no evaluation. Daily loss 3% on the greater of end-of-day balance or equity. Max 20 lots on 50K. EAs disabled; no weekend holding; cannot be merged or scaled. Leverage FX 1:30. Sizes $2.5K-$200K. FUNDED40 code (40% off) applies to Alpha Direct only in October 2026.

news_trading: Restricted: free during evaluation phases on all plans. Qualified accounts (Pro, One, Three, Direct): no opening or closing trades on the targeted instrument from 5 minutes before to 5 minutes after the release; trades opened more than 5 minutes earlier can be held; speeches/conferences restricted for their whole duration plus 5 minutes. Alpha Swing Qualified: news trading allowed, but trades opened within 2 minutes of a release must stay open longer than 2 minutes
ea_bots_allowed: Restricted: MT5 only, trade-management EAs only, with prior approval (send the EX5 file); EAs that trade independently are prohibited; not available on cTrader, DXtrade, TradeLocker, swap-free or Alpha Direct accounts
copy_trading: Restricted: allowed from your own verified external account as Master or between your own Alpha Capital accounts (one Master at a time, account numbers sent in advance); copying other traders or groups is prohibited; not available from cTrader, DXtrade or TradeLocker
overnight_weekend_holding: Overnight allowed on all plans (swaps apply). Weekend: Alpha Pro allowed in Phases 1-2, not on the Qualified account (profits from those trades removed); Alpha Swing, One and Three allowed at all stages; Alpha Direct not allowed
restricted_countries_note: Restricted: Afghanistan, Belarus, Burundi, Central African Republic, Chad, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Republic of Congo, Crimea, Eritrea, Iran, Iraq, Cuba, North Korea, Libya, Myanmar, Somalia, Sudan, South Sudan, Russia, Syria, Yemen, Venezuela, Vietnam, sanctioned areas of Ukraine (Donetsk, Luhansk, Crimea, Kherson, Zaporizhzhia). and US residents: MT5 not available; cTrader closed to new US customers; DXtrade and TradeLocker available.
path_to_live: Alpha Prime (London prop firm in the same group): traders are reviewed after a $40,000 single payout, five payouts from one Qualified account, or $100,000 lifetime payouts; qualified traders move from simulated accounts to Alpha Prime live accounts with a 60% split plus a monthly salary

current_public_promo.applies_to: All accounts, valid October 1-31, 2026, per Alpha Capital's promo codes page

affiliate_program.notes: No affiliate or partner program page found on alphacapitalgroup.uk or in the help center (help searches for 'affiliate' and 'referral' return nothing; the Terms do not describe one). The About page says a staff member oversees 'partnerships and affiliate programs' but gives no link or terms. Serbia eligibility for affiliates: not stated.
